collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — DREAMS AND AMBITIONS (DRM-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Big dreams, small dreams, secret dreams and silly ones: things villagers hope for, work toward, give up on, change their minds about, or simply enjoy imagining. Ambition is optional, and a dream that never comes true is not a sad ending.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager's secret goal is to make a hard-to-amuse friend laugh until they snort: go through with the plan, or abandon it.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject)'s secret ambition, which (subject.he/she) has never told anyone, is to make (friend) laugh so hard that (friend.he/she) snorts. (friend) is famously hard to make laugh. (subject) has been working on it for a year. Tonight, at dinner, (subject) has a plan involving a fish, a hat and a very silly voice.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) puts on the hat, holds up the fish, and does the voice. (friend) stares. (subject)'s confidence wobbles. Then (friend)'s mouth twitches, and twitches again, and suddenly (friend.he/she) is laughing helplessly, and somewhere in the middle of it comes a loud, unmistakable snort. (subject) keeps a perfectly straight face, and privately decides this is the best day of the year.

o2__fx.name: Outcome B
o2__fx.text: (subject) chickens out at the last moment and just eats (subject.his/her) fish. Halfway through the meal, (subject.he/she) chokes on a piece of it, recovers, and says in a very small voice, "That went down the wrong way." For some reason (friend) finds this so funny that (friend.he/she) snorts. (subject) doesn't know whether that counts.
